page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 8 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the ecs.sn2.3xlarge delivers average multi-core performance but exhibits weaker single-core capabilities. In stress-ng testing, single-core CPU performance is categorized as weak, while multi-core performance is average. Similarly, Geekbench scores show a weak single-core result of 1001.0 and an average multi-core result of 6324.0. Memory bandwidth benchmarks, including large block read and write operations, consistently fall within the average range. Single-threaded tasks, such as gzip compression and bzip3 decompression, perform poorly or weakly, whereas multi-threaded bzip3 decompression achieves average performance.

This instance is suitable for general-purpose workloads that can leverage multi-threaded processing, such as static web serving, database operations, and software compilation, where it demonstrates average benchmark performance. It is also capable of handling light LLM inference tasks for small models, though performance drops significantly on larger models. Given its dedicated hardware allocation and balanced resource profile, the ecs.sn2.3xlarge offers a stable, mid-range compute option without the overhead of local storage or specialized accelerators.
